name: Madquick WP Legal Pages – One Click, 100% Free
author: Madquick Digital Agency Private Limited

sections.description:
Madquick WP Legal Pages – One Click, 100% Free is an all-in-one WordPress plugin that helps website owners instantly create essential legal pages with zero setup and no hidden costs.

Generate Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Cookie Policy, Refund & Return Policy, Disclaimer, DMCA Notice, Affiliate Disclosure, Shipping Policy, and custom legal pages in just one click.

The plugin also includes free bonus features such as a cookie consent banner, strong password enforcement, browser update alerts, and automatic external link nofollow control. Everything runs locally on your WordPress site with no signup and no external data sharing.

Key Features

  • 10 Legal Page Generators – Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Cookie Policy, Refund Policy, Return Policy, Disclaimer, DMCA Notice, Affiliate Disclosure, Shipping Policy, and Custom Legal Pages
  • One-Click Generation – Create professional legal pages in 60 seconds with simple forms
  • 100% FREE Forever – No hidden costs, no premium upsells, no credit card required
  • GDPR & CCPA Compliance – Built-in templates to help meet privacy law requirements
  • Cookie Consent Banner – FREE GDPR-compliant cookie banner with vendor script management
  • Browser Update Banner – Notify users with outdated browsers to upgrade for better security
  • Strong Password Checker – Enforce strong password requirements on login and registration
  • External Links SEO Control – Automatically add nofollow and noreferrer attributes to external links
  • Mobile Responsive – All generated pages and banners work perfectly on mobile devices
  • Easy Customization – Edit generated pages directly in WordPress editor
  • No Signup Required – Everything runs locally on your WordPress site
  • Zero Data Collection – Your data never leaves your server

Why Use This Plugin?

Staying compliant with privacy regulations like GDPR and CCPA is critical for any website. This plugin simplifies the process by:

  • One-Click Setup – Generate any legal page in under 60 seconds
  • Legally-Sound Templates – Professional templates covering all major legal requirements
  • Customizable Forms – Match your specific business needs with simple forms
  • User Consent Management – Cookie banners and consent tracking included
  • Enhanced Security – Password strength requirements and browser update alerts
  • Complete Privacy – Everything runs locally, no external data sharing

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin (100% FREE)
  2. Navigate to Madquick WP Legal Pages in your WordPress admin
  3. Choose which legal page you want to create (10 types available)
  4. Fill out the simple form with your website information
  5. Click “Generate” to create your legal page instantly
  6. Customize the generated page if needed in WordPress editor
  7. Configure FREE bonus features (cookie banner, password checker, etc.)

Privacy & Data

This plugin does NOT collect, store, or transmit any user data to external servers. All data remains on your WordPress installation.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact:

  • Email: tech@madquick.in
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Madquick-Private-Limited/madquick-ppg

License

You can find more details in the LICENSE.txt file included with this plugin.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Madquick WP Legal Pages”
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Start creating legal pages for FREE!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Access the plugin via Madquick WP Legal Pages in your admin menu
  7. Create your first legal page in 60 seconds!
sections.faq:
Can I customize the generated privacy policy?

Yes! After generating your privacy policy, you can edit it directly in the WordPress page editor just like any other page.

Does this plugin ensure GDPR compliance?

The plugin provides templates and tools that aid in GDPR and CCPA compliance. However, you should review all generated content with a legal professional to ensure it meets your specific legal requirements.

Can I disable the cookie banner?

Yes. Navigate to Madquick WP Legal Pages > Settings and uncheck “Enable Cookie Banner” to disable it. All features are optional and can be toggled on/off.

Does the strong password checker work on login and registration?

Yes. When enabled, the password checker validates password strength on both user login and registration forms.

Can I generate multiple legal pages?

Yes! You can generate unlimited legal pages. We provide 10 different types: Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Cookie Policy, Refund Policy, Return Policy, Disclaimer, DMCA Notice, Affiliate Disclosure, Shipping Policy, and Custom Legal Pages. Create as many as you need – it’s 100% FREE with no limits!

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads necessary assets on relevant pages.

What does the External Links NoFollow feature do?

When enabled in settings, this feature automatically adds rel=”nofollow noreferrer” attributes to all external links on your website. This gives you better SEO control by preventing search engines from following external links and improves privacy by not sending referrer information to external sites. This is a FREE bonus feature!

Is this really 100% free?

Yes! There are no hidden costs, no premium versions, no upsells, and no credit card required. All features are completely FREE forever. We believe every website deserves proper legal pages without breaking the bank.
